title: Curved cantilever: refined mesh
description: Same annular-strip geometry and constitutive data as coarse companion; 24x4 mesh.
geometry: 125 nodes; 96 elements. Same annular-strip geometry and constitutive data as coarse companion; 24x4 mesh.
material: E=1e+07, nu=0.25; shell thickness=0.1. Consistent benchmark units; displacements in deck length unit, forces in deck force unit, stress in force/length^2
boundary_conditions: Clamped start edge; unit resultant at the free edge.
loading: Total Fy=1 at the free section; five nodal weights 0.125, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.125.

references.citation: MacNeal, R.H.; Harder, R.L. (1985). A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy. Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1, 3-20.

observations: The separately retained MH_curved_beam_in_plane companion tests the same published target. Coarse-mesh error is displayed and is not relabeled as validation success.
limits: Linear elasticity and small-displacement equilibrium or linearized bifurcation/modal analysis; this is computational verification, not a material-test validation.
figure_caption: Recorded JFEM result; deformation is amplified, mode amplitudes/signs arbitrary. Green triangles mark constrained nodes; magenta arrows mark available point loads.
